scope: General structural Expression grouping and separate application adaptation; no production parser/compiler implementation supplied
phase_contract: P0 preserves the source Structure graph.
The effect-free grouper derives structural operation/dependency units and streams at the current level under receiving contracts.
No source-only, written-group, parenthesis or returned-object flag selects graph grouping.
Expression application adaptation packages one left actual/reference bundle and right Array of references; wrapping left is not the grouping pass.
Ordinary demand, input roles, mode, admission and result handling apply; no separate conditional opening pass follows.

The clean-graph CODE/Expression walker handles anonymous Structures as groups; named Structures are groups only when actual parent differs from the current lexical owner, otherwise ordinary receiver/call handling applies. Whole VALUE/TYPE/DATA gates remain.
Built-in :: remains DATA-only; its PASS_ARGS_AS_IS metadata is unspecified because implementation is absent.
Every present left has the same internal LeftView: focus occurrence, complete value plan and pending context. No parser branch selects :=, PLACE or NAME.
The resolved operand method uses ordinary namespace consumption: whole VALUE plan versus selected PLACE/NAME focus; unconsumed context resumes with the declared result.
Argument delivery never moves prefix right[0] into absent left. Equivalent prefix/one-left assignment effects are implemented inside the assignment method only.
Attached unary operations retain their general left/right side class with exactly one atom, not a fixed ++/-- exception list.
compatibility: The previous bare group-copy prohibition and single-written-RHS-group requirement are superseded by the author clarification.
The former conditional RHS wording is explained by current-level sequence contracts plus single-left application packaging, not a universal TYPE-model opening condition.
RAW complete expressions retain their whole original occurrence; legacy physical-token argument-count assumptions are not preserved.
A public two-Array operand ABI and arbitrary free operand placement are not introduced.

Named reference grouping requires an actual parent different from the current lexical owner. The earlier unqualified no-call/reference-group statement is corrected; anonymous Structures remain groups regardless of parent.
